notes.title: Game Update
notes.content: Today, we released a small patch to address issues with correctly displaying the player level on the main menu and fixing missing objectives on the objectives screen.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hi Brawlers,

Today we have released an update to OutRage: Fight Fest with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added multiple new Steam achievements
[*] Added more map variety to some game modes
[*] Added more announcer voice-over dialogue lines
[*] Blue Minard's training trail can now be accessed from the training menu
[*] Several bug fixes
[*] Disabled Party Mode
[/list]

Our in-game party system previously made use of an external service provider. We're no longer able to utilise this external service, so for the time being, the party feature has been disabled. You can still join a game with your friends using the custom lobby mode.

notes.title: We're at NEXT FEST - RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h1]Next Fest[/h1]

We're delighted to announce that we'll be participating in this summer's Steam Next Fest, which will start in just one week on Monday, the 10th!

Be sure to follow [i]OutRage: Fight Fest[/i] for further announcements about our playable demo and developer live streams during the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/cf1925a7f520d071e39da9bb617d01746118ae6e.png[/img]

[h1]Release Date[/h1]

Here is the news you've been waiting for......

OutRage: Fight Fest will be releasing into Early Access on Steam on [b]July 16th![/b]

If you haven't already, please add [i]OutRage: Fight Fest[/i] to your wishlist to make sure you don't miss further announcements or the release.

You can also get more news by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/outrage]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Demo Update - Now With 16 Players
notes.content:
The OutRage: Fight Fest Demo received an update today, so jump into the fight and take a look.

[list]
[*] Survival mode renamed to Knockout
[*] Knockout and Domination modes now support 16 players
[*] Knockout now lasts for three rounds as 16 players are reduced to 8, and then the final 4
[*] You can now choose your character from the t-shirt icon at the top of the main menu
[*] Larger arenas added for 16-player games
[*] New flow to the tutorial mode to ensure players find the combo training
[*] Various UI updates
[*] Various Quality of Life improvements.
[/list]

Don't forget to add OutRage: Fight Fest to your Steam wishlist.

The full game will have;

[list]
[*] More Modes
[*] More Maps
[*] More Characters
[*] More Weapons
[*] More Abilities
[*] More Chaos
[/list]

Get Mad, Get Big, Get Even!

notes.title: Demo Out Now
notes.content:
Brawler enthusiasts everywhere, the time has come. The OutRage: Fight Fest demo is now available to all! Pull on your costume and step into the arena.

Take part in a four-player Survival match where only one contestant can be left standing. Would you prefer to go in with some backup? Domination is the game for you. Head into the arena with a team and capture and hold the control points.

First time stepping into the arena? Visit the training area and practice your moves on the autonomous training dummies.

Brawling is always more fun with friends, so share the demo far and wide. Create private events just for you and your friends and share arena codes with them so they can join you.

The OutRage: Fight Fest demo will give you a taste of brawling mayhem.

In the release version of OutRage: Fight Fest, you can expect:

[list]
[*] A multitude of different character skins will expand as you play and level up.
[*] 4 tide-changing "OverRage" special abilities, with even more to come after launch.
[*] 5 game modes, each allowing up to 16 players.
[*] Varied arena themes with ever-changing layouts to hunt down your opponents.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/d4a6afe8c41c141a9b7d95772e7cc571d8fede66.png[/img]

Add OutRage: Fight Fest to your Steam wishlist today. Download the demo, invite your friends, and throw them at your other friends.

[h2]GET MAD, GET BIG, GET EVEN![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/cf1925a7f520d071e39da9bb617d01746118ae6e.png[/img]

Demo Content:
[list]
[*] 5 different character skins, randomly selected.
[*] 2 different game modes - Solo Survival (4 player) and Domination (8 player).
[*] 2 game worlds, Downtown and Dockyard with variations.
[*] 1 OverRage ability - "Rage'nade".
[*] Custom games - host your own game and share the code with friends to play together.
[*] Training mode - learn the ropes and practice your combos.
[*] Practice mode - take on 3 bots in a timed score challenge.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/d7a7821d8387a7eb0812fb88dc4dbbff8cac5853.png[/img]

The full game will also feature:
[list]
[*] Duo Survival: Team up with a friend in a battle royale.
[*] Pain Points: Play solo or in a team and score points by causing as much damage to others as possible.
[*] Rage Bank: Work as a team to gain and deposit Rage to score points.
[*] Crate Grab: You and your team must work together to deliver your crates home while delaying the opposition.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/0beef992973d286d402088d84aa3dca9a3118c36.png[/img]

All game modes in OutRage: Fight Fest will support up to 16 players.

A Windows-compatible Xbox or Playstation type controller is recommended for playing OutRage: Fight Fest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/15559e55fcadd9645af304f92cacafd5f0935378.png[/img]

In the demo, you will see only a small selection of arenas. You will enjoy many arena themes and varied layouts in the final release.

[url=https://discord.gg/outrage][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541087/a741ffeaca77f6796df9eed99ffa6b69b0b5c737.png[/img][/url]

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/outrage]Discord[/url] where you can meet the developers and arrange play-sessions with others. Come along and challenge the devs, if you think you can take the beating!

notes.title: Community Build Update
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] You can now choose between two OverRage abilities from the customisation menu. 
[*]- ‘Flame On!’ increases your speed and damage values for a short period.
[*]- 'Grenade' triggers an explosive AOE, after a short-fuse countdown, to deal damage to the area around your brawler. 

[*] You can now create custom rooms and share room codes so you can pile into modes of your choosing with your friends and followers.

[*] We’ve added lots of new Survival maps for you to brawl in.

[*] There is now a training level you can access from the main menu that walks you through the basics of combat and is a space to practice combos and throw aiming.

[*] Message Of The Day tells you when the next playtest is happening and links to our discord channel.

[*] Health pips no longer drop from all objects but from special green-coloured ones. Keep an eye out for vending machines on some maps that drop health packs when you interact with them.
[/list]

 

[h2]Combat Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Weapons now fling opponents away from you and deal additional damage. Try to hit players into their teammates or hazards to maximise your rage gain!

[*] Kick has a slightly longer range.

[*] Sprint Attack - This attack, that can allow you to attack players you are chasing, is only available after sprinting for a while. Press punch when you see your character flash mid-sprint to trigger a Sprint Attack with your fist or any weapon you are holding. Sprint Attacks can be avoided with a well timed roll.

[*] Rolling uses up more stamina, so it's easier to punish opponents who try to spam roll.

[*] You now receive bonus rage for dealing damage to higher Evo opponents. Take the risk, and reap the reward… This means you’ll Rage Up more quickly and see more Evo 3 players at the end of matches.
[/list]

 
[h2]
Improvements / Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New grab and kick animations.

[*] Rage Bar has a new look and a new position on the screen.

[*] The camera position has been tweaked to give you more view of the bottom of the screen.

[*] Fixed the majority of issues where players can be pushed through floors or walls. We’ll get the rest of them in our next release.

[*] Better colour distinguishing between teams

[*] Fixed a bug where you could receive no Rage for throwing opponents into a hazard.

[*] New VFX shows you and your opponents when your OverRage ability is ready to be used.

[*] Lots of art improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

 

[h2]Notes and Known Issues:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The custom lobby doesn’t prevent you from starting team modes with low player numbers, which can cause various issues - 8 players or more is the ideal number to start a team mode.

[*] The Grenade AOE indicator doesn’t display correctly on all ground textures.
[/list]

notes.title: September Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Since the announcement of OutRage, we haven’t given an update on where we are and what we’re working on. This doesn’t mean we haven’t been really busy behind the scenes, so I’d like to share with you what is coming next.

Many of you will know that we’ve been running regular playtest sessions for the OutRage pre-alpha since the announcement. At the moment, these tests are very small-scale and exclusively with those people who are members of our Discord community.

Because of the small scale and the fact our community is spread throughout multiple timezones, it can be difficult to get enough players all online at the same time for these sessions.
In our October update, we’re adding several new features that will make it easier for you to set up your own sessions with other community members.

Firstly, we’re adding a custom lobby system with lobby codes. This means anyone can start up their own lobby, choose the game mode and map, and then share the lobby code with other players. Anyone using that code to join will find themselves in your lobby, even if they live in a different region. Want to play with your friend who doesn’t have access? All they will need to do is go to the Steam store page and hit the playtest button to get in or join the Discord! Then, you share your lobby code with them, and they can join you.

We’re also adding a message of the day to the title screen. This will allow us to communicate the dates and times of the following test to everyone directly in the game without having to rely on Discord. 

We have some new maps coming in for our Survival mode to help keep things feeling fresh.
We’ve also been tweaking the combat and have added animations to make everything feel smoother. 
We're trying out some new ways of delivering health during matches and have plans on adding an explosive new Over Rage attack. We can't wait to see how you guys use these new systems!

Finally, we’re introducing a new training area where you will be able to learn and practice the art of combat outside of a live multiplayer game. This will give everyone the opportunity to get to grips with the game before jumping in to play with others and offer a way to practice whenever you want.
We still have many more new and exciting things on the roadmap for OutRage, and we’ll be adding them periodically to our community test build as we develop the game.

The more people we have in our community, the more easily we can find others to play with - so please do invite your friends, and we’ll get them into the tests.

If you haven’t already done so, please consider joining our Discord community at https://discord.gg/outrage - We really do appreciate your support and enthusiasm.

Until the next update, keep kicking ass!
